comment: AdMob Configuration file. You can replace the IDs below with your Google AdMob account IDs when you are ready to monetize.

instructions.hindi: Apne AdMob account se App ID and Ad Unit IDs copy karke is file me or android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml me paste kar dijiye. Fir GitHub Actions automatically nayi APK bana dega!
instructions.english: Copy your App ID and Ad Unit IDs from your Google AdMob dashboard and paste them into this file and android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml. Then trigger the GitHub Actions workflow to get your production APK!
